title: Kitchen tools and what they do

source.name: Hand-built, checked row by row against English Wikipedia
source.method: enwiki: the tool articles (Whisk, Spatula, Colander, Ladle (spoon), Rolling pin, Grater, Peeler, Tongs, Can opener, Corkscrew, Garlic press, Potato masher, Mortar and pestle, Meat tenderizer, Pizza cutter, Measuring cup, Sieve, Nutcracker, Skewer, Cutting board, Funnel, Cookie cutter, Chef's knife, Toaster, Bottle opener, Cleaver, Trivet, Dutch oven, Wok, Frying pan, Saucepan, Pressure cooker, Weighing scale, Salad spinner, Sheet pan) and Kitchen knife

does.pick: In the kitchen, what does the {label} do?
does.statement: In the kitchen, the {label} does this: {value}.
does.match: Match each kitchen tool to what it does.
does.reverse: Which kitchen tool is described this way: {value}?

rows.label: Mortar and pestle
rows.does: Grinds spices and herbs into paste or powder

rows.label: Dutch oven
rows.does: Slow-cooks stews and braises in a thick lidded pot

rows.label: Kitchen scale
rows.does: Weighs ingredients by mass

rows.label: Pressure cooker
rows.does: Cooks food fast in a sealed pot using trapped steam

rows.label: Cleaver
rows.does: Chops through bone and thick cuts

rows.label: Toaster
rows.does: Browns slices of bread with radiant heat

rows.label: Wok
rows.does: Stir-fries over high heat in a deep round pan

rows.label: Sieve
rows.does: Sifts flour and separates fine bits from coarse ones

rows.label: Spatula
rows.does: Flips and lifts food in a pan

rows.label: Colander
rows.does: Drains boiled pasta and rinses vegetables

rows.label: Can opener
rows.does: Cuts the lid off a metal tin

rows.label: Chef's knife
rows.does: All-purpose blade for chopping and slicing

rows.label: Frying pan
rows.does: Browns and sears food in a shallow vessel with a long handle

rows.label: Whisk
rows.does: Beats air into mixtures and blends them smooth

rows.label: Ladle
rows.does: Scoops soup and stew into bowls

rows.label: Funnel
rows.does: Guides liquid into a narrow opening

rows.label: Skewer
rows.does: Holds chunks of food together for grilling

rows.label: Nutcracker
rows.does: Breaks open hard shells

rows.label: Tongs
rows.does: Grip and lift hot food without using hands

rows.label: Saucepan
rows.does: Simmers liquids on the stovetop in a deep pot with one long handle

rows.label: Corkscrew
rows.does: Pulls the stopper out of a wine bottle

rows.label: Grater
rows.does: Shreds cheese and vegetables into fine pieces

rows.label: Cutting board
rows.does: Protects the counter while you chop

rows.label: Peeler
rows.does: Strips the skin off potatoes, carrots and apples

rows.label: Baking sheet
rows.does: Flat metal tray that holds cookies and rolls in the oven

rows.label: Bottle opener
rows.does: Pops off crimped metal caps

rows.label: Measuring cup
rows.does: Gauges the volume of liquids and dry ingredients

rows.label: Rolling pin
rows.does: Flattens dough into a sheet

rows.label: Cookie cutter
rows.does: Presses shapes out of rolled dough

rows.label: Pizza cutter
rows.does: Rolls through a baked round flatbread to portion it into wedges

rows.label: Potato masher
rows.does: Squashes soft cooked vegetables into a lumpy puree

rows.label: Salad spinner
rows.does: Dries washed leafy greens by whirling them

rows.label: Garlic press
rows.does: Crushes cloves by forcing them through small holes
